extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed final mechanism ontology from local XML/PDF text and figure captions; no database-only mechanism claims promoted.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: L18R produced a low but significant apoptotic-cell signal after peptide treatment; L12P did not differ from untreated control under the same assay conditions.

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=9:Induction of apoptosis in C. albicans cells

mechanism_claims.limitations: The claim is limited to assay-observed phosphatidylserine externalisation/dead-cell profile; it does not establish a full molecular apoptotic pathway.

mechanism_claims.entity_scope: FITC-labeled L12P and L18R on living Candida albicans SC5314 cells
mechanism_claims.claim_text: Confocal microscopy supports peptide-cell interaction and internalisation, with L12P entering most cells within minutes and L18R first binding the cell surface followed by progressive internalisation.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Microscopy supports cellular entry/association and death under imaging conditions but does not identify a single molecular target.

mechanism_claims.entity_scope: L12P and L18R-treated Candida albicans cells
mechanism_claims.claim_text: Transmission and scanning electron microscopy show treated-cell ultrastructural changes, including cytoplasmic changes, membrane retraction/cell wall alteration, debris, leakage, and deformed yeast cells.

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=11:Visualisation of the effects of L12P and L18R peptides on C. albicans cells by transmission and scanning electron microscopy

mechanism_claims.limitations: Classified as morphology/ultrastructure evidence for membrane or cell-envelope damage; not promoted to a specific biochemical target.

not_promoted_claims.reason: The local paper does not provide direct nucleic-acid binding or target assays for L12P/L18R; prior automated placeholder was removed.

not_promoted_claims.claim: host immune modulation as direct mechanism
not_promoted_claims.reason: The paper discusses immunoglobulin-gene origin and in vivo infection survival but does not provide direct immune-modulation assays for the peptides.
